label: CTFtime (capture-the-flag events)
terms_note: Public JSON API, no key, HTML docs. The site answers 403 to curl's default User-Agent (the runtime's own User-Agent is accepted, live 2026-10-01). /events/?start=<now> returns every upcoming event (37 on 2026-10-01; `limit` caps it at 100); /results/ returns the current year's final scores keyed by event id, with team ids only. An unknown event answers a 404 HTML page.

discover.note: Upcoming CTF events, soonest first (status is always 'upcoming'; past events are under standings). kind is the format: Jeopardy, Attack-Defense, Hack quest. query matches title or description.

get_competition.note: One event by CTFtime id; rules_url is the organisers' site.

standings.note: Final scoreboard of an event that finished THIS calendar year (CTFtime publishes results per year); team is the CTFtime team id. An event without published results gives an empty list.

not_offered.me: No accounts in the public API.
not_offered.my_entries: Team participation needs a login; not in the public API.
not_offered.enter: Registration happens on each event's own site; not an API call.
not_offered.submit: Flags are submitted on each event's own platform.

live_check.notes: all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
